## What it is

A geospatial data science project examining how environmental stressors (climate change, human clearing, anthropogenic activity) have impacted forest cover in Rwanda's Nyungwe Nature Reserve, a 1,013 km² rainforest reserve experiencing regional warming of roughly a third of a degree per decade.

## What I did

- Collaborated with the US Forest Service and a faculty advisor to analyze temporal trends and environmental stressors affecting forest cover in the reserve
- Used ArcGIS Pro and Google Earth Engine to develop training points from August 2019 and July 2022 satellite imagery for land cover classification
- Built a MaxEnt species/habitat distribution model to support the project's initial analysis and reporting
